purpose: reconcile cross-view car/bus/truck label conflicts without treating crops as independent probability observations
base: unchanged pinned YOLOX-S full plus3 squares, local/global classwise NMS .45, confidence .3; no learned-weight or camera changes
conflict_edges: different class AND different source view AND f32 IoU strictly>.45 among existing global outputs
components: connected components; reconcile only pairwise-complete components with distinct classes and distinct source views; otherwise keep all outputs and report ambiguity
votes: use existing merge with all other views empty to restore and edge-filter each view; eligible original proposals have component classes and IoU>.45 to EVERY component member; highest-confidence eligible proposal supplies at most one vote per view
selection: class with most distinct view votes; tied full-image vote wins if among tied classes; otherwise highest vote confidence then lower class id
representative: highest-ranked existing global output of selected class; retain original class/confidence/box/origin; no geometry or probability fusion
ordering: retain original global output order; every suppression records original ranks and votes; no hidden class/category removal
evaluated_data: all8 previously viewed BDD records and138 unchanged original scoped references; no fresh holdout claim; no numeric labels parsed in this turn before freeze

evaluation.relative_adoption: retain every earlier78 reference match and every per-class count, reduce false positives below33; otherwise no recommendation over original tiled detector
evaluation.protocol: independent all-box/lineage/vote recomputation, controlled full-view tie and non-clique ambiguity, malformed inputs, native inference on all8 twice, original full+tiled detections unchanged
evaluation.calibration: report descriptive fixed5-bin Brier/ECE; correlated views do not yield calibrated confidence

defaults: all previous binaries and source-bound evidence remain unchanged; explicit new binary only
